preconditions.description: The root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**6 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in list(root))
preconditions.description: Each node's value must be between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the maximum path sum from a leaf to the root.
The maximum path sum must be at least -1,000,000.
The maximum path sum must be at most 1,000,000.
